<script>
// --- DOUBLE BOX COPY LOGIC ---
window.copyQid = function(qid) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(qid).then(() => {
        const btns = [document.getElementById('copy-btn-' + qid), document.getElementById('copy-btn-res-' + qid)];
        btns.forEach(btn => {
            if(btn) {
                const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
                // Temporarily replace with a Green Checkmark to show it worked
                btn.innerHTML = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg>`;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
                }, 1500);
            }
        });
    }).catch(err => console.error('Failed to copy', err));
};
</script>

<script>
// GLOBAL audio player 
let currentAudio = null;

function playAudio(url, lang = "") {
    try {
        if (currentAudio) {
            if (currentAudio.src === url) {
                if (!currentAudio.paused) {
                    currentAudio.pause();
                    return;
                } else {
                    currentAudio.play();
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                currentAudio.pause();
                currentAudio = null;
            }
        }

        currentAudio = new Audio(url);
        currentAudio.play();

        currentAudio.onended = () => {
            currentAudio = null;
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Audio play error:", e);
    }
}
</script>

<script>
/**
 * Build printable DOM for the current test (questions[] should be present).
 * Uses defensive checks so it works for different question shape variants.
 */
function buildPrintableTestHtml() {
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.style.fontFamily = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
  wrapper.style.padding = "18px";
  wrapper.style.color = "#111";

  const pageTitle = (document.querySelector('.header-text')?.textContent
                     || (typeof ALL_TESTS !== 'undefined' && ALL_TESTS && ALL_TESTS[quizId] && ALL_TESTS[quizId].title)
                     || quizId || 'Test');
  const meta = (document.querySelector('.subheader-text')?.textContent || '');

  // Header
  const header = document.createElement('div');
  header.innerHTML = `<h1 style="margin:0 0 6px; font-size:18px;">${pageTitle}</h1>
                      <div style="margin-bottom:12px; color:#444; font-size:13px;">${meta}</div>
                      <hr/>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(header);

  // Iterate questions array (defensive: accept several field names)
  (questions || []).forEach((q, idx) => {
    // question text - try several common keys
    const qText = q.raw_text || q.text_html || q.text || q.question || q.stem || q.question_text || q.questionHtml || '';
    const qBlock = document.createElement('div');
    qBlock.style.marginBottom = '14px';
    qBlock.className = 'question-block';

    const qHead = document.createElement('div');
    qHead.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">Q${idx+1}. ${qText}</div>`;
    qBlock.appendChild(qHead);

    // Insert question images (if any). Generator uses keys like 'question_images'
    const qImgs = q.question_images || q.images || q.questionImages || [];
    if (Array.isArray(qImgs) && qImgs.length) {
      const imgWrap = document.createElement('div');
      imgWrap.style.margin = '8px 0';
      qImgs.forEach((src, j) => {
        if (!src) return;
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = src;
        img.alt = `Q${idx+1} image ${j+1}`;
        // print-friendly sizing
        img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        img.style.height = 'auto';
        img.style.display = 'block';
        img.style.margin = '6px 0';
        imgWrap.appendChild(img);
      });
      qBlock.appendChild(imgWrap);
    }

    // Build options list if available
    const opts = q.options || q.options_json || q.choices || q.optionList || q.optionsArr || q.answers || [];
    if (Array.isArray(opts) && opts.length) {
      const ol = document.createElement('ol');
      ol.style.margin = '6px 0 0 18px';
      ol.style.padding = '0';
      ol.style.fontSize = '14px';
      
        opts.forEach((optRaw, oi) => {
          // normalize label and option text in a robust way
          let label = String.fromCharCode(65 + oi); // default A,B,C...
          let text = "";
          let isCorrect = false;

          if (typeof optRaw === "string") {
            text = optRaw;
          } else if (optRaw && typeof optRaw === "object") {
            // common shapes: { label: "A", text: "..." } or { option: "...", correct: true }
            label = (optRaw.label || optRaw.id || label);
            text = optRaw.text || optRaw.option || optRaw.html || optRaw.label || JSON.stringify(optRaw);
            isCorrect = !!(optRaw.correct || optRaw.isCorrect || optRaw.is_correct || optRaw.correct === true);
          } else {
            text = String(optRaw);
          }

          // get a single-letter uppercase representation for the option label (A, B, C, ...)
          // if label is a number (1/2/3) convert -> A/B/C
          function labelToLetter(l, idx) {
            if (l === null || l === undefined) return String.fromCharCode(65 + idx);
            const s = String(l).trim();
            // direct letter
            const m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z])\.?$/);
            if (m) return m[1].toUpperCase();
            // numeric -> map 1 -> A, 2 -> B etc.
            if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
              const n = parseInt(s, 10);
              if (n >= 1 && n <= 26) return String.fromCharCode(64 + n);
            }
            // fallback: take first char and uppercase (useful for weird labels)
            return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
          }

          const labelLetter = labelToLetter(label, oi);

          const li = document.createElement('li');
          li.style.marginBottom = '6px';

          // sanitize/display option text (keep simple)
          const displayText = String(text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
          li.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:600; margin-right:8px;">${labelLetter}.</span> ${displayText}`;

          // === robust selected-answer detection ===
          const selRaw = (typeof answers !== 'undefined') ? answers && answers[idx] : null;
          let selNormalized = null;

          if (selRaw !== null && selRaw !== undefined) {
            if (typeof selRaw === 'string') {
              selNormalized = selRaw.trim().toUpperCase();
              // accept forms like "A" or "A." or "a"
              const m = selNormalized.match(/^([A-Z])\.?$/);
              if (m) selNormalized = m[1];
              // also accept strings like "1" -> convert to letter
              else if (/^\d+$/.test(selNormalized)) {
                const n = parseInt(selNormalized, 10);
                if (n >= 1 && n <= 26) selNormalized = String.fromCharCode(64 + n);
              }
            } else if (typeof selRaw === 'number') {
              // numeric index (0-based) -> map to letter
              selNormalized = String.fromCharCode(65 + selRaw);
            } else if (Array.isArray(selRaw)) {
              selNormalized = selRaw.map(s => (String(s || "").trim().toUpperCase()))
                                   .map(s => {
                                     const m = s.match(/^([A-Z])\.?$/);
                                     if (m) return m[1];
                                     if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
                                       const n = parseInt(s, 10);
                                       if (n >= 1 && n <= 26) return String.fromCharCode(64 + n);
                                     }
                                     return s.charAt(0) || "";
                                   });
            } else {
              // fallback stringify
              selNormalized = String(selRaw).trim().toUpperCase();
            }
          }

          // check match (either string equality or membership for arrays)
          let selMatches = false;
          if (selNormalized !== null && selNormalized !== undefined && selNormalized !== "") {
            if (Array.isArray(selNormalized)) {
              selMatches = selNormalized.includes(labelLetter);
            } else {
              selMatches = String(selNormalized) === labelLetter;
            }
          }

          if (selMatches) {
            li.style.background = '#e6ffed';
            li.style.padding = '4px';
            li.style.borderRadius = '4px';
          }

          // highlight correct answer (unchanged behaviour)
          if (isCorrect) {
            li.style.borderLeft = '4px solid #22c55e';
            li.style.paddingLeft = '8px';
          }

          ol.appendChild(li);
        });

      qBlock.appendChild(ol);
    }

    
    // Inject user's answer textually (show 'Your Answer:')
    try {
      const userSel = (typeof answers !== 'undefined') ? (answers && answers[idx]) : null;
      if (userSel !== null && userSel !== undefined && userSel !== "") {
        // helper to escape HTML (safe small helper)
        const _esc = (s) => String(s===null||s===undefined?'':s)
            .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
        // attempt to find option text from q.options if available
        let optText = '';
        if (Array.isArray(q.options)) {
          const found = q.options.find(o => String(o.label).trim().toUpperCase() === String(userSel).trim().toUpperCase());
          if (found) optText = (found.text || found.label || '');
        } else {
          // fallback: look for option_1..option_16 fields
          for (let oi2=1; oi2<=16; oi2++) {
            const key = 'option_' + oi2;
            if (q[key]) {
              const label = String.fromCharCode(64+oi2);
              if (label === String(userSel).trim().toUpperCase()) { optText = q[key]; break; }
            }
          }
        }
        const yourAnsDiv = document.createElement('div');
        yourAnsDiv.style.marginTop = '6px';
        yourAnsDiv.style.fontSize = '13px';
        // prefer option HTML/text, otherwise show the raw label
        yourAnsDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">Your Answer:</div><div>' + (_esc(optText) || _esc(userSel)) + '</div>';
        qBlock.appendChild(yourAnsDiv);
      }
    } catch(e) { console.warn('Failed to render Your Answer in printable: ', e); }
// Explanation (try multiple field names). Explanations may include HTML (but generator may strip <img> and provide explanation_images)
    const explanationHtml = q.explanation || q.exp_html || q.explain || q.solution || q.answer_detail || q.explanation_html || '';
    if (explanationHtml) {
      const exp = document.createElement('div');
      exp.style.marginTop = '8px';
      exp.style.fontSize = '13px';
      exp.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">Explanation:</div><div>${explanationHtml}</div>`;
      qBlock.appendChild(exp);
    }

    // Append explanation images if generator provided them separately
    const expImgs = q.explanation_images || q.explanationImages || q.exp_images || [];
    if (Array.isArray(expImgs) && expImgs.length) {
      const expImgWrap = document.createElement('div');
      expImgWrap.style.marginTop = '8px';
      expImgs.forEach((src, j) => {
        if (!src) return;
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = src;
        img.alt = `Explanation image ${idx+1}-${j+1}`;
        img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        img.style.height = 'auto';
        img.style.display = 'block';
        img.style.margin = '6px 0';
        expImgWrap.appendChild(img);
      });
      qBlock.appendChild(expImgWrap);
    }

    wrapper.appendChild(qBlock);

    if ((idx + 1) % 10 === 0) {
      // page break suggestion for long tests
      const hr = document.createElement('hr');
      hr.style.margin = '14px 0';
      wrapper.appendChild(hr);
    }
  });

  return wrapper;
}

// ------------------------- Questions-only PDF generator -------------------------
/**
 * Build printable DOM with ONLY questions + question images + options.
 * No explanations. No correct-answer highlighting. No selected-answer highlighting.
 */
/**
 * Build printable DOM with ONLY questions + question images + options.
 * Tries to convert remote images to data: URIs (fetch->blob->FileReader) so html2canvas/html2pdf
 * can include them. Falls back to the original URL if CORS prevents conversion.
 */
function buildPrintableQuestionsOnlyHtml() {
  // basic sanitizer: removes <script>, on* attributes and iframes, keeps basic formatting tags
  function sanitizeHtml(input = "") {
    if (typeof input !== "string") return "";
    let out = input.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, "");
    out = out.replace(/\son\w+\s*=\s*"(?:[^"]*)"/gi, "");
    out = out.replace(/\son\w+\s*=\s*'(?:[^']*)'/gi, "");
    out = out.replace(/<iframe[\s\S]*?>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe>/gi, "");
    out = out.replace(/(href|src)\s*=\s*"(javascript:[^"]*)"/gi, "");
    // allow only basic formatting tags (b,i,u,em,strong,sub,sup,br,p,ol,ul,li,span)
    out = out.replace(/<\/?(?!b\b|i\b|u\b|em\b|strong\b|sub\b|sup\b|br\b|p\b|ol\b|ul\b|li\b|span\b)[^>]+>/gi, "");
    return out;
  }

  // strip <img> tags from HTML text (we render images separately)
  function stripImgTags(html = "") {
    return String(html).replace(/<img[^>]*>/gi, "");
  }

  // single fetch->dataURL helper (works only if server allows CORS)
  async function fetchToDataUrl(url) {
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(url, { mode: "cors" });
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("fetch failed " + resp.status);
      const blob = await resp.blob();
      return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const fr = new FileReader();
        fr.onload = () => resolve(fr.result);
        fr.onerror = reject;
        fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // rethrow so caller falls back to direct src
      throw err;
    }
  }

  const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
  wrapper.style.fontFamily = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
  wrapper.style.padding = "18px";
  wrapper.style.color = "#111";

  const pageTitle =
    (document.querySelector(".header-text")?.textContent ||
      (typeof ALL_TESTS !== "undefined" && ALL_TESTS && ALL_TESTS[quizId] && ALL_TESTS[quizId].title) ||
      quizId || "Test");
  const meta = (document.querySelector(".subheader-text")?.textContent || "");

  // header
  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.innerHTML = `<h1 style="margin:0 0 6px; font-size:18px;">${pageTitle}</h1>
                      <div style="margin-bottom:12px; color:#444; font-size:13px;">${meta}</div>
                      <hr/>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(header);

  (questions || []).forEach((q, idx) => {
    // prefer HTML-ish fields, but strip their <img> tags
    const rawQHtml = q.raw_text || q.text_html || q.text || q.question || q.stem || q.question_text || q.questionHtml || "";
    const qHtmlNoImgs = stripImgTags(rawQHtml);
    const qSan = sanitizeHtml(qHtmlNoImgs).trim() || "<em>(No question text)</em>";

    const qBlock = document.createElement("div");
    qBlock.className = "question-block";
    qBlock.style.marginBottom = "14px";

    // question header
    const qHead = document.createElement("div");
    qHead.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">Q${idx + 1}. ${qSan}</div>`;
    qBlock.appendChild(qHead);

    // question images (render images if generator populated question_images array)
    const qImgs = q.question_images || q.images || q.questionImages || [];
    if (Array.isArray(qImgs) && qImgs.length) {
      const imgWrap = document.createElement("div");
      imgWrap.style.margin = "8px 0";

      qImgs.forEach((src, j) => {
        if (!src) return;

        // Create image element immediately (so layout & wait-for-images can see it)
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.alt = `Q${idx + 1} image ${j + 1}`;
        img.style.maxWidth = "100%";
        img.style.height = "auto";
        img.style.display = "block";
        img.style.margin = "6px 0";
        img.decoding = "async";

        // Try setting crossOrigin & referrer for best chance with CORS
        try { img.crossOrigin = "Anonymous"; } catch (e) {}
        try { img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer"; } catch (e) {}

        // Append immediately so waitForImagesToLoad sees the element
        imgWrap.appendChild(img);

        // Async attempt: convert to data URI if possible, else fallback to remote URL
        (async () => {
          try {
            if (typeof src === "string" && src.startsWith("data:")) {
              img.src = src;
              return;
            }
            const dataUrl = await fetchToDataUrl(src);
            if (dataUrl) img.src = dataUrl;
            else img.src = src;
          } catch (err) {
            // CORS or fetch failed -> fallback to direct URL
            console.warn("fetchToDataUrl failed, falling back to direct src:", err);
            img.src = src;
          }
        })();
      });

      qBlock.appendChild(imgWrap);
    }

    // options: support strings or objects with label/text
    const opts = q.options || q.options_json || q.choices || q.optionList || q.optionsArr || q.answers || [];
    if (Array.isArray(opts) && opts.length) {
      const ol = document.createElement("ol");
      ol.style.margin = "6px 0 0 18px";
      ol.style.padding = "0";
      ol.style.fontSize = "14px";

      opts.forEach((optRaw, oi) => {
        let label = String.fromCharCode(65 + oi); // default A,B,C...
        let rawOpt = "";
        if (typeof optRaw === "string") {
          rawOpt = optRaw;
        } else if (optRaw && typeof optRaw === "object") {
          label = optRaw.label || label;
          rawOpt = optRaw.text || optRaw.option || optRaw.label || (optRaw.html || "");
          if (typeof rawOpt === "object" && rawOpt !== null && rawOpt.html) rawOpt = rawOpt.html;
        } else {
          rawOpt = String(optRaw);
        }

        // remove any embedded <img> inside option text (images shown separately)
        const optNoImgs = stripImgTags(String(rawOpt || ""));
        const optSan = sanitizeHtml(optNoImgs);

        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.style.marginBottom = "6px";
        li.style.listStyle = "none";
        li.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:600; margin-right:8px;">${label}.</span> ${optSan}`;

        ol.appendChild(li);
      });

      qBlock.appendChild(ol);
    }

    wrapper.appendChild(qBlock);

    // page-break suggestion every 10 questions
    if ((idx + 1) % 10 === 0) {
      const br = document.createElement("div");
      br.style.pageBreakAfter = "always";
      br.style.margin = "14px 0";
      wrapper.appendChild(br);
    }
  });

  return wrapper;
}


/**
 * Print Questions-only by opening a new window and calling print().
 * This bypasses html2canvas/html2pdf canvas CORS issues and reliably includes remote images.
 */
async function printQuestionsOnly() {
  if (!Array.isArray(questions) || questions.length === 0) {
    alert("No questions loaded.");
    return;
  }

  // Build the printable DOM (questions-only)
  const printable = buildPrintableQuestionsOnlyHtml();
  // Apply minimal print-safe wrapper styles
  printable.style.background = "#fff";
  printable.style.padding = "20px";
  printable.style.color = "#000";
  printable.style.boxSizing = "border-box";

  // Prepare print CSS (keeps images responsive and prevents splitting where possible)
  const printCss = `
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>${(document.title || "Questions").replace(/[\\\/:*?"<>|]+/g,"_")}</title>
    <style>
      html,body { background:#fff; color:#000; margin:0; padding:20px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }
      h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
      ol { margin-left:18px; padding:0; }
      li { margin-bottom:6px; }
      img { max-width:100%; height:auto; display:block; margin:6px 0; page-break-inside: avoid; }
      .question-block { page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; -webkit-column-break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 16px; }
      @media print {
        img { max-width:100% !important; height:auto !important; }
        .question-block { page-break-inside: avoid !important; break-inside: avoid !important; }
        body { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
      }
    </style>
  `;

  // Open a new window/tab for printing
  const win = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!win) {
    alert("Popup blocked. Please allow popups for this site and try again.");
    return;
  }

  // Remove scripts from the clone for safety, then serialize
  const printableClone = printable.cloneNode(true);
  printableClone.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(s => s.remove());

  // Write content into the new window
  win.document.open();
  win.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head>${printCss}</head><body>${printableClone.outerHTML}</body></html>`);
  win.document.close();

  // Wait for images in the new window to finish loading (or error)
  try {
    const waitForWindowImages = () => new Promise(resolve => {
      try {
        const imgs = win.document.images || [];
        if (imgs.length === 0) return resolve();
        let loaded = 0;
        const checkDone = () => {
          loaded++;
          if (loaded >= imgs.length) resolve();
        };
        for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
          const im = imgs[i];
          if (im.complete) checkDone();
          else { im.addEventListener('load', checkDone, { once:true }); im.addEventListener('error', checkDone, { once:true }); }
        }
        // safety timeout fallback
        setTimeout(resolve, 8000);
      } catch (e) { resolve(); }
    });
    await waitForWindowImages();
  } catch (e) {
    // continue to print even if waiting failed
    console.warn("Image waiting in print window failed:", e);
  }

  // Focus and call print dialog (user saves to PDF)
  try {
    win.focus();
    win.print();
    // optional: close after a short delay (commented because some browsers block scripted close)
    // setTimeout(() => win.close(), 1000);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Print failed:", e);
  }
}




/**
 * Wait for ALL images inside element to finish loading (or error), with a timeout.
 * Returns a Promise that resolves when done.
 */
function waitForImagesToLoad(containerEl, timeoutMs = 8000) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const imgs = Array.from(containerEl.querySelectorAll("img"));
      if (imgs.length === 0) return resolve();

      let finished = 0;
      const total = imgs.length;
      let done = false;

      const markDone = () => {
        if (done) return;
        finished++;
        if (finished >= total) {
          done = true;
          resolve();
        }
      };

      imgs.forEach(img => {
        if (img.complete) {
          markDone();
        } else {
          img.addEventListener("load", markDone, { once: true });
          img.addEventListener("error", markDone, { once: true });
        }
      });

      // timeout fallback
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!done) {
          done = true;
          resolve();
        }
      }, timeoutMs);
    } catch (e) {
      // on weird errors, just resolve
      resolve();
    }
  });
}

            max-width: 100% !important;
            height: auto !important;
          }
        }
      </style>
    `;

    // 4️⃣ Clone printable DOM (remove scripts for safety)
    const printableClone = printable.cloneNode(true);
    printableClone.querySelectorAll("script").forEach(s => s.remove());

    // 5️⃣ Write content into new window
    win.document.open();
    win.document.write(`
      <!doctype html>
      <html>
        <head>${printHead}</head>
        <body>${printableClone.outerHTML}</body>
      </html>
    `);
    win.document.close();

    // 6️⃣ Wait for images INSIDE print window to load
    await new Promise(resolve => {
      const imgs = Array.from(win.document.images || []);
      if (imgs.length === 0) return resolve();

      let done = 0;
      const check = () => {
        done++;
        if (done >= imgs.length) resolve();
      };

      imgs.forEach(img => {
        if (img.complete) {
          check();
        } else {
          img.addEventListener("load", check, { once: true });
          img.addEventListener("error", check, { once: true });
        }
      });

      // safety timeout
      setTimeout(resolve, 10000);
    });

    // 7️⃣ Trigger browser print (user chooses "Save as PDF")
    win.focus();
    win.print();

    // Optional auto-close (some browsers block it, so commented)
    // setTimeout(() => win.close(), 1200);

    btn.textContent = prevText || "Download Questions Only PDF";
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Questions-only PRINT error:", err);
    alert("Failed to open print window. Check console for details.");
  } finally {
    try {
      btn.disabled = false;
    } catch (e) {}
  }
});




/**
 * Trigger PDF generation for ONLY the current test loaded (questions[], quizId).
 * Uses browser print (open new window) — robust for images and complex CSS.
 */
async function generateCurrentTestPDF() {
  if (!questions || !questions.length) {
    alert("No test loaded");
    return;
  }

  const printable = buildPrintableTestHtml();
  printable.id = "print-area";

  // Basic reset for printable bundle
  printable.style.all = "initial";
  printable.style.fontFamily = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
  printable.style.color = "#000";
  printable.style.background = "#fff";
  printable.style.padding = "20px";

  // Prepare HTML for new window. Include print-safe CSS that forces images to scale and prevents page-break-inside where possible.
  const titleEscaped = (typeof ALL_TESTS !== 'undefined' && ALL_TESTS && ALL_TESTS[quizId] && ALL_TESTS[quizId].title) ? ALL_TESTS[quizId].title.replace(/[\\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '_') : document.title;
  const win = window.open("", "_blank");

  const printCss = `
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <style>
      html, body { background: #fff; color: #000; }
      body { margin: 0; padding: 20px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }
      h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
      ol { margin-left: 18px; padding: 0; }
      li { margin-bottom: 6px; }
      img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 6px 0; page-break-inside: avoid; }
      .question-block { page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; -webkit-column-break-inside: avoid; -webkit-region-break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 16px; }
      hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; margin: 14px 0; }
      @media print {
        img { max-width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; }
        .question-block { page-break-inside: avoid !important; break-inside: avoid !important; }
        body { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
      }
    </style>
  `;

  // Clone printable and remove any <script> tags (safety) before serializing
  const printableForPrint = printable.cloneNode(true);
  printableForPrint.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(s => s.remove());

  // Write content
  win.document.open();
  win.document.write(`
    <html>
      <head>
        <title>${titleEscaped}</title>
        ${printCss}
      </head>
      <body>
        ${printableForPrint.outerHTML}
      </body>
    </html>
  `);
  win.document.close();

  // WAIT for images to load (or error) in the pop-up before printing
  const attemptPrintWhenReady = () => {
    try {
      const imgs = win.document.images;
      const total = imgs.length;
      if (total === 0) {
        try { win.focus(); win.print(); } catch(e){ console.warn("Print failed:", e); }
        return;
      }
      let loaded = 0;
      const doneIfReady = () => {
        loaded++;
        if (loaded >= total) {
          // small delay to ensure layout stabilised
          setTimeout(() => {
            try { win.focus(); win.print(); } catch(e) { console.error("Print call failed:", e); }
          }, 80);
        }
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
        const im = imgs[i];
        if (im.complete) {
          doneIfReady();
        } else {
          im.addEventListener('load', doneIfReady, { once: true });
          im.addEventListener('error', doneIfReady, { once: true });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // If cross-window access fails for some reason, fallback to printing after a short delay
      console.warn("Image-waiting failed or blocked, falling back to immediate print:", e);
      setTimeout(() => { try { win.focus(); win.print(); } catch(err){} }, 300);
    }
  };

  // Try to use onload, but also schedule a fallback call
  win.onload = () => { setTimeout(attemptPrintWhenReady, 50); };
  // Fallback if onload doesn't fire quickly
  setTimeout(attemptPrintWhenReady, 300);
}


// Hook the download button
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('download-pdf');
  if (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
      ev.preventDefault();
      btn.disabled = true;
      const previousText = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Generating PDF...';
      try {
        await generateCurrentTestPDF();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("PDF generation failed:", e);
        alert("PDF generation failed. See console for details.");
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = previousText || 'Download PDF';
      }
    });
  }
});

// ----------------- Exit confirmation (mobile back / unload) -----------------
function enableExitConfirmation() {
    if (window.__exitGuardInstalled) return;
    window.__exitGuardInstalled = true;

    // Try to push a stable state so mobile back triggers popstate instead of leaving immediately
    try {
        history.pushState({page: 'quiz', id: quizId}, '', '#quiz');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('history.pushState failed', e);
    }

    // When user presses back (popstate) while quiz visible, show exit modal instead
    window.addEventListener('popstate', function (ev) {
        try {
            const quizEl = document.getElementById('quiz');
            const quizVisible = quizEl && !quizEl.classList.contains('hidden');
            if (quizVisible) {
                const exitModal = document.getElementById('exit-modal');
                if (exitModal) exitModal.classList.remove('hidden');

                // Re-push state so further back doesn't immediately leave
                try { history.pushState({page: 'quiz', id: quizId}, '', '#quiz'); } catch (e) {}
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('popstate handler error', err);
        }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Warn on reload/close while quiz is active
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function (e) {
        try {
            const quizEl = document.getElementById('quiz');
            const quizVisible = quizEl && !quizEl.classList.contains('hidden');
            if (quizVisible) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.returnValue = '';
                return '';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            // ignore
        }
    });
}
}
